name: multica
description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.

capability_evidence.mobile-access: re open to mainland-China Feishu only for now; DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram are community-maintained.
capability_evidence.worktree-isolation: your environment (main checkout or worktree), creates the env file,
capability_evidence.usage-analytics: play every tool call, command, and error, timestamped.
capability_evidence.security-isolation: en an agent needs a call, not for every step.
capability_evidence.self-hosted: is a source-available workspace where you assign work to AI coding agents the way you'd
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via curl | sh installer, PowerShell irm | iex installer; configure environment variables, database dependency; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 curl | sh installer、PowerShell irm | iex installer 安装；需配置 environment variables、database dependency；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: Agents that show up on the board.
highlights: CLI and API → Every surface is scriptable.
Autopilots → Run standups, audits, and reports on a cron — nobody to remind.
Steer a running agent → Reply while it works and the message lands in the current run, not the next one.
analysis.summary_zh_native: Multica 是一个源码公开的团队工作区。你像给同事派活一样，把任务交给 AI 编码智能体——它自己接手、边做边 汇报、卡住了主动说，做完交回来给你审。可自托管，支持你已经在用的智能体 CLI，不绑定任何厂商。
highlights_zh: 你已经在用的智能体 CLI → Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Kimi、OpenCode 等等。
CLI 与 API → 界面上能点的，CLI 和 API 里都能调。
Web、桌面端、移动端 → macOS、Windows、Linux、iPhone、iPad，打开都是同一个工作区——iOS App 现在要自己从源码编译安装，还没上 App Store。
自动化 → 日报、巡检、周报按 cron 自己跑，不用有人催。
